title: District Plan and Maps
previewText: The regulations of this Chapter are designed to implement the District Plan for the Special Forest Hills District. The District Plan includes the map of the Special Forest Hills District, which is set forth in the Appendix to this Chapter and is hereby incorporated as part of this Resolution for the purpose of specifying locations where the special regulations and requirements set forth in this Chapter apply.
